q: What should I say when a verifier asks why one month's emissions spike?
title: Explaining a spike month to a verifier
short: Give the operational reason with a record behind it: a big order, a breakdown that ran the diesel generator, a bill covering two months, or a fuel delivery that filled the tank. Then show the figure is right or correct it. A spike with no reason is where verifiers dig deeper.

ul: Two billing periods in one bill.
Bulk fuel delivery counted when bought, not burned.

p: Production register, generator log, outage notices or the delivery challan. Note the explanation next to the figure before the audit.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure tied to its invoice, factor and method version, so a verifier can trace any number back to the document it came from.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements (iso.org)
